source: Compiled from Ancient Aliens (History Channel) recurring claims, researcher publications
note: Each theory is a testable proposition extracted from speculative framing

theories.title: Giza Pyramids as Power Plants
theories.claim: The internal structure of the Great Pyramid generated or conducted electrical energy through piezoelectric properties of granite and resonant chamber acoustics
theories.testable_prediction: Measurable electromagnetic output or residual EM traces in granite blocks
current_evidence_for: Granite contains quartz (piezoelectric)
King's Chamber resonates at specific frequencies
Subterranean chamber acoustics match power generation models
current_evidence_against: No wiring, conductors, or storage components found
No electromagnetic residue detected in any survey
Conventional tomb explanation supported by inscriptions

theories.title: Puma Punku Precision Machining
theories.claim: The H-blocks and precision-cut stones at Puma Punku were created using advanced machining technology beyond known Tiwanaku capabilities
theories.testable_prediction: Tool marks consistent with diamond-tipped or laser cutting rather than stone/copper tools
current_evidence_for: Extremely precise 90-degree angles
Repeating modular shapes suggesting templates
Hard andesite stone difficult to work with copper
current_evidence_against: Experimental archaeology demonstrates achievable with stone tools
No machine tool artifacts found
Similar precision in other pre-industrial cultures (Japan, Egypt)

theories.title: Nazca Lines as Landing Strips
theories.claim: The Nazca Lines in Peru were created as directional markers or landing strips for aerial vehicles
theories.source: Erich von Daniken (1968) 'Chariots of the Gods'
theories.testable_prediction: Lines would need to support landing weight; surface compaction patterns would differ from foot traffic
current_evidence_for: Lines only fully visible from air
Some resemble modern airstrips in shape
Enormous scale suggests aerial perspective needed for design
current_evidence_against: Lines too narrow and soft for landing (would collapse)
Ground composition is loose pebbles over clay
Wooden stakes with attached strings found (survey tools)
Similar designs achievable with simple geometry from ground level

theories.title: Elongated Skulls as Non-Human DNA
theories.claim: Elongated skulls found in Paracas, Peru contain DNA not matching any known human haplogroup, indicating non-terrestrial or unknown hominin origin
theories.source: Brien Foerster, Lloyd Pye, Ancient Aliens S09E01
theories.testable_prediction: Full genome sequencing would reveal non-human genetic sequences
current_evidence_for: Some skulls have unusual cranial volume beyond artificial deformation
Brien Foerster's 2014 preliminary DNA test reported 'unknown haplogroup'
current_evidence_against: Intentional cranial deformation documented in 40+ living cultures
2018 peer-reviewed DNA study (University of California) confirmed Paracas skulls as fully human with Native American haplogroups
Foerster's lab was not peer-reviewed or independently replicated

theories.title: Orion Correlation Theory
theories.claim: The three Giza pyramids were deliberately positioned to mirror the three stars of Orion's Belt as they appeared in 10,500 BCE
theories.testable_prediction: Geometric match between pyramid positions and Belt star positions resolves at one specific precessional epoch
current_evidence_for: Angular offset of Menkaure matches Mintaka offset from Belt line
Shaft alignments target Orion's Belt stars
Layout angle matches Belt angle at 10,500 BCE precession
current_evidence_against: Ed Krupp (Griffith Observatory) argues the orientation is inverted
Mainstream Egyptology dates pyramids to ~2560 BCE not 10,500 BCE
Other star patterns could fit with enough freedom in positioning

theories.title: Younger Dryas Impact and Lost Civilization
theories.claim: A comet impact at 12,800 BP caused the Younger Dryas cooling event, destroying an advanced pre-Ice Age civilization whose survivors transmitted knowledge to later cultures
theories.source: Graham Hancock (2015) 'Magicians of the Gods', Randall Carlson
theories.testable_prediction: Impact markers (nanodiamonds, iridium, melt glass) at 12,800 BP globally; evidence of advanced construction predating 10,000 BCE
current_evidence_for: Younger Dryas Boundary layer nanodiamonds confirmed at 50+ sites globally (Firestone et al. 2007, confirmed by multiple labs)
Gobekli Tepe (9600 BCE) shows sophisticated construction before agriculture
Rapid sea level rise (120m) would have submerged coastal civilizations
current_evidence_against: No physical remains of pre-Ice Age advanced civilization found
Gobekli Tepe shows no metal tools or advanced technology
YDB impact hypothesis disputed by some geologists (van Hoesel 2014)

theories.title: Great Sphinx Water Erosion (pre-5000 BCE)
theories.claim: The vertical weathering patterns on the Great Sphinx enclosure walls indicate water erosion from sustained heavy rainfall, dating the monument to before 5000 BCE when the Sahara was wet
theories.testable_prediction: Weathering patterns match rainfall erosion and NOT wind/sand erosion; geological dating of weathering depth indicates pre-dynastic age
current_evidence_for: Geologist Robert Schoch confirmed vertical fissuring consistent with water erosion
Saharan wet period (African Humid Period) ended ~5000 BCE
Adjacent structures show different (wind) weathering patterns
200+ geologists at GSA 1991 presentation agreed with water erosion identification
current_evidence_against: Egyptologist Mark Lehner attributes erosion to salt weathering and capillary action
No other artifacts from pre-5000 BCE found at Giza
Sphinx head style matches Khafre-era portraiture

theories.title: Angkor-Draco Correlation
theories.claim: The layout of the Angkor temple complex in Cambodia mirrors the constellation Draco as it appeared at 10,500 BCE
theories.testable_prediction: Temple positions map to Draco star positions with angular precision at one specific precessional epoch
current_evidence_for: Temple positions approximate Draco shape
Spring equinox alignment at Angkor Wat confirmed
Same 10,500 BCE epoch as Giza-Orion correlation
current_evidence_against: Temples built over 400 years (9th-13th century CE) — not a single plan
Angular match is approximate and requires selective temple inclusion
No Khmer texts reference Draco or 10,500 BCE

theories.title: Acoustic Levitation of Megaliths
theories.claim: Ancient builders used sound frequencies to levitate and transport massive stone blocks, explaining megalithic construction without modern machinery
theories.source: Ancient Aliens multiple episodes, Tibetan acoustic levitation legend
theories.testable_prediction: Demonstrated acoustic levitation of objects exceeding 1kg at audible frequencies
current_evidence_for: Small-scale acoustic levitation demonstrated in laboratories (milligram scale)
Multiple ancient traditions describe 'singing stones into place'
Coral Castle (Edward Leedskalnin) claimed secret method for moving 30-ton blocks alone
current_evidence_against: No laboratory demonstration above milligram scale
Physics: energy required scales with mass^2 — tonnage would require continent-shaking power
Experimental archaeology demonstrates drag sleds, ramps, and water lubrication work for multi-ton blocks
Coral Castle blocks were concrete, not solid coral

theories.title: Global Flood Memory as Real Event
theories.claim: The appearance of flood narratives across 200+ unrelated cultures records a real global inundation event, possibly the post-Ice Age sea level rise between 14,000-7,000 BCE
theories.source: Graham Hancock, Randall Carlson, comparative mythology
theories.testable_prediction: Submerged coastal structures from pre-8000 BCE civilization; flood narratives correlate temporally with documented sea level pulses (Meltwater Pulse 1A, 1B)
current_evidence_for: 200+ flood narratives documented across unrelated cultures
Sea level rose 120m between 14,000-7,000 BCE (confirmed by coral reef dating)
Meltwater Pulse 1A (~14,600 BP) raised sea level 20m in 500 years — catastrophic for coastal populations
Submerged structures found off India (Dwarka), Japan (Yonaguni), and Mediterranean
current_evidence_against: Flood myths could arise independently from local river flooding
Submerged structures disputed (Yonaguni may be natural formation)
No single global flood event — sea level rose over millennia, not overnight
